source: The City of Calgary, 2026 Budget as approved (December 3, 2025), Budget Overview, Operating Revenue table, page 24 of 158

lines.name: Property tax, including levies
lines.note: Tax increases on existing properties, tax from new and redeveloped properties, local improvement and community revitalization levies.

lines.name: Sales of goods and services
lines.note: Mostly the water utility (16.5% of all revenue) and waste and recycling (3.7%).

lines.name: Return on equity
lines.note: The ENMAX dividend and contributions from the self-supported water utilities.

lines.name: Franchise fees
lines.note: Paid by utility companies to The City in lieu of property taxes, for the right to deliver their services in Calgary.
